_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: First interior repaint spec. Combined prime + finish. Context prefix WLRP (wall repaint) confirmed — no collision with existing prefixes. TSK_WALL_* is NC wall prime; WLRP avoids collision.

paintable_items.name: Wall Field Repaint Surface
paintable_items.notes: Combined prime+finish RP item. Phase suffix _RP used to avoid collision with existing ITM_WALL_FIELD_PRIME (NC prime spec). NC prime and finish are separate spec families sharing wall_field surface, creating the collision condition that justifies the suffix.

paintable_items.name: Ceiling Edge Cut-In (from wall perspective)
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from NC wall prime. Same physical edge work applies in RP context.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_WALL_* is used by NC wall prime. TSK_WLRP_* is unique for RP wall tasks. Checked against id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use — WLRP not present.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_WLRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. RP-NEW tasks use this prefix. DIRECT transfer tasks from NC may retain original TSK_WALL_* prefix where appropriate, but SOP Librarian should prefer re-issuing under TSK_WLRP_* for consistency in a combined spec.

expected_modules.notes: Furniture move/cover, floor protection, trim masking, fixture covers
RP-specific: condition scan, adhesion test, moisture eval, coating ID. No NC equivalent.
Degloss, scrape, feather, contamination treatment, fill/patch, dust removal
State-driven primer: adhesion / stain-block / mildew-resistant. Conditional on substrate_state.
Sand between coats (QT4+), inspect, dust removal
Cut-in + roll/spray/spray_backroll finish coats. Interstage between finish coats.
Protection teardown, furniture replace, customer walkthrough, tool clean, vacuum
Shared lead-safe RRP module. Conditional on PS_META.BOOL.HOME_PRE_1978. Shared across all 9 interior RP specs. Pre-existing ID from research — not owned by this spec.

paintscope_keys.description: Total paintable wall field area (excluding openings)
Linear footage of wall-to-ceiling boundary for edge cut-in
Linear footage of wall-to-trim boundary for cut-in at trim edges. RP always has trim in place — NC could skip this.
paintscope_keys.notes: New PS key. NC wall prime had no trim adjacency. RP always has trim installed. Distinct from PS_PROTECT_LF.TRIM_EDGES (protection masking LF) — this is cut-in work LF.

paintscope_keys.description: Perimeter floor protection area for roll method
Full floor protection area for spray overspray
Room count — drives per-room heuristics (fixture count, furniture protection, customer walkthrough)
Floor area for post-application vacuum cleanup
Surface condition enum (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) for condition modifier selection
paintscope_keys.notes: New PS key for RP condition assessment. Values from condition_scale enum.

paintscope_keys.description: Wall surface texture for texture modifier selection
paintscope_keys.notes: New PS key. Texture modifier applies to coverage rate and application speed.

paintscope_keys.description: Ceiling height classification for height modifier selection
Room floor area for furniture protection coverage. RP-specific — occupied home context.
paintscope_keys.notes: New PS key for furniture protection zone. Conditional on occupancy_state.

paintscope_keys.description: Trim perimeter for masking before wall work. RP always has trim in place.
paintscope_keys.notes: New PS key. NC wall prime could skip trim masking because trim was not installed. RP cannot.

paintscope_keys.description: Interior substrate state classification (SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT through SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE). Captured during assessment phase.
paintscope_keys.notes: New PS key. Drives primer selection logic. Distinct from SURFACE_CONDITION (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) which drives prep intensity.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag indicating home built before 1978, triggering RRP lead-safe module.
paintscope_keys.notes: New PS key. Activates MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT shared module. Derived from project onboarding year_built.

paintscope_keys.description: Contamination type: none, mildew, smoke, water_stain, grease. Drives primer selection and treatment task activation.
paintscope_keys.notes: New PS key. RP-specific contamination assessment.

quality_tier.notes: QT2 included for economy repaint (landlord refresh, rental turnover). QT2 is roll-only.

application_method.notes: Roll is primary for occupied RP. spray_backroll at QT3+. spray at QT4+ (rare in occupied). brush excluded — wall specs do not use brush-only.

sheen.notes: Eggshell is default for residential walls. Gloss excluded (trim-only per doctrine). Satin/semi-gloss require QT4+.

phase.notes: 'apply' phase not used — this spec uses prime and finish directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: EA_ROOM for per-room heuristics (furniture, walkthrough). FIXED for assessment tasks and tool cleanup. SF for wall field. LF for edges.

uom_input.notes: ENUM for condition_scale, surface_texture, height_band, substrate_state, contamination_type. BOOL for home_pre_1978.

substrate_state.notes: All 5 input states are in controlled_enums.json (SS_INT_* added for interior RP). All output states are existing SS_PAINTED_* values. Matte maps to SS_PAINTED_FLAT per ceiling convention.

condition_scale.notes: Universal 3-level scale from controlled_enums.json. GOOD=SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT. FAIR=SS_INT_FAILING_PAINT/SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE. POOR=SS_INT_PEELING/SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE.

surface_texture.notes: skip_trowel treated as heavy_texture for modifier purposes per research.

floor_type.notes: RP is always 'finished' (occupied home). Included for schema completeness.

protection_level.notes: floor_perimeter=edge_only, floor_full=full_cover, fixture_covers=full_cover (spray) or item_mask (roll QT4+), trim_edges=light_mask, furniture_room=full_cover, ceiling_line=none.

edge_type.notes: All wall adjacencies are linear (wall-to-ceiling, wall-to-trim). No complex edges.

typical_relationship.notes: Wall-to-ceiling and wall-to-trim are all different_finish.

product_role.notes: This spec uses primer (3 state-driven systems) and finish (3 QT-driven systems). Specialty for shellac stain-blocker if classified separately.

surface_ids.notes: All surfaces are in id_registry.json entries_in_active_use. No new surface IDs needed.

zone_ids.notes: Roll method floor protection. edge_only level.
Outlet/switch/fixture masking. Required for spray; optional (QT4+) for roll.
New zone for RP trim masking. Tape line at baseboard, door casing, window casing, crown, chair rail edges. Not in NC wall specs because trim was not installed during NC wall work.
New zone for RP furniture protection. Occupied home context. Furniture center-piled and covered with poly sheeting.
Per doctrine: wall painter cuts into ceiling freehand — protection level is 'none'. Exists in zone registry for documentation.

primer_systems_to_create.name: Interior Adhesion Primer
primer_systems_to_create.notes: Adhesion promoter for sound/failing/peeling paint. Water-based. New system — not in id_registry.

primer_systems_to_create.name: Interior Stain-Blocking Primer (Shellac-Based)
primer_systems_to_create.notes: Shellac stain blocker for smoke damage. Full surface application. New system.

primer_systems_to_create.name: Interior Mildew-Resistant Primer
primer_systems_to_create.notes: Mildew-resistant primer for moisture damage. After biocide treatment. New system.

finish_systems_to_consider.notes: Standard 100% acrylic latex wall paint. Same product class as NC wall finish. New system ID — NC wall finish spec (referenced_not_built) does not have formal SYS_ IDs yet.
Premium acrylic with better leveling and hide.
Top-tier paint. Maximum hide, leveling, durability.

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_PRIMER_BONDING — similar adhesion concept but targeted at smooth/hard substrates (cabinets). SYS_PRIMER_ADHESION_INT is distinct — it targets previously painted surfaces with potential adhesion issues, not smooth factory surfaces.
material_system_prefix.notes: 3 new primer systems + 3 new finish systems = 6 total new SYS_ IDs. Primer selection is state-driven (not QT-driven). Finish selection is QT-driven (same pattern as NC).

proposed_new_consumables.name: Liquid Sander / Chemical Degloss
proposed_new_consumables.notes: Krud Kutter Gloss-Off or equivalent. RP-specific — chemical degloss for adhesion prep.

proposed_new_consumables.name: TSP Powder (Trisodium Phosphate)
proposed_new_consumables.notes: Surface cleaning for grease, smoke residue, general contamination. RP-specific.

proposed_new_consumables.name: Bleach / Mildewcide Solution
proposed_new_consumables.notes: Biocide treatment for mildew-affected areas. RP-specific — SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE.

proposed_new_consumables.name: Poly Sheeting for Furniture Protection (2-4 mil)
proposed_new_consumables.notes: Furniture covering in occupied homes. RP-specific.

proposed_new_consumables.name: Adhesion Test Kit (Cross-Hatch Cutter + Tape)
proposed_new_consumables.notes: ASTM D3359 cross-hatch tape test. RP assessment phase tool.

proposed_new_consumables.name: Denatured Alcohol (Shellac Cleanup)
proposed_new_consumables.notes: Required for shellac stain-blocker tool cleanup. SYS_PRIMER_STAINBLOCK_INT uses shellac — standard water cleanup does not work.

proposed_rounds.description: Prime + 1 finish coat (QT2 economy or QT3 with full coverage)
No prime + 1 finish coat (GOOD condition, QT2)
No prime + 2 finish coats (GOOD condition, QT3-QT5 when adhesion test passes)

round_configurations.notes: RP round configs are more complex than NC because primer is conditional on substrate state. GOOD condition may skip primer entirely. FAIR/POOR always prime. Coat count driven by QT.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for adhesion primer on previously painted wall
Coverage rate for shellac stain-blocker on smoke-damaged wall
Coverage rate for mildew-resistant primer on moisture-damaged wall
Coverage rate for finish coat on smooth wall
Coverage rate for finish coat on textured wall (orange peel / knockdown / heavy)

spec_specific.notes: Per research EST-002: COND_FAIR from Modifier_Registry
Per research EST-002: COND_POOR from Modifier_Registry
Highest contamination modifier — shellac adds significant time and complexity

stacking_partition.notes: Height and texture stack independently on both pools. Wall_access is shared between pools. Pools are never cross-applied.

comp_modifiers_affected_by: COMP_CLOSET_SHELVING — 1.5x modifier when closet shelving present in same room. Affects wall specs.
shared_modules: MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT — lead-safe work practices (shared across all 9 interior RP specs)

materials_json.notes: 6 new material systems (3 primer + 3 finish). 6 new consumables. Coverage profiles optional but recommended.

sop_modules_json.notes: 7 spec-owned modules + 1 shared module (MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT). Assessment module is RP-new. Phase ordering: setup > prep(assessment+remediation) > prime > interstage > finish > cleanup.

production_json.notes: Assessment tasks use FIXED or EA_ROOM rates. Scrape/feather rates are new with wide ranges. Finish rates transfer from NC.

qa_report_json.notes: severity: critical/major/minor only. ISS_ prefix for issues.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup > prep > prime > apply > interstage > finish > cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: TSK_ context prefix from resolution.json (WLRP) MUST be used for all new task IDs
RULE 10: ITM_ IDs marked 'existing' MUST use exact registered ID — no synonyms
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use ONLY enum values from resolution.json applicable_enums
migration_warnings: No direct migration items from agent_rules.json migration_checklist affect this spec. However, ensure CON_ prefix (never CONS_), task_classification (never task_class), phase values from controlled_enums (never 'protect'/'protection'), and uppercase units throughout.

warnings.message: Research maps matte sheen -> SS_PAINTED_FLAT. This is correct per ceiling convention but should be documented — SS_PAINTED_MATTE exists in controlled_enums but is not used as an output state here. Materials Manager and spec author should confirm this mapping.
warnings.recommendation: Accept mapping as-is. SS_PAINTED_FLAT is the canonical 'flat/matte' output.

warnings.topic: Contamination modifier values are research estimates
warnings.message: FAC_WLRP_CONTAM_* values (1.10-1.50) are proposed by Researcher but flagged as uncertainty U-004. Not yet in Modifier_Registry.md. Estimation Engineer should use these as initial values with wide ranges and flag for field calibration.
warnings.recommendation: Use proposed values. Flag in production.json for field validation.

warnings.topic: Wall access modifier values are research estimates
warnings.message: FAC_WLRP_ACCESS_* values (1.0/1.15/1.30) are proposed by Researcher but flagged as uncertainty U-003. Not yet in Modifier_Registry.md.
warnings.recommendation: Use proposed values. Flag in production.json for field validation.

warnings.topic: Scrape/feather production rates have wide ranges
warnings.message: Per research uncertainty U-001: scrape 50-100 SF/hr, feather 40-80 SF/hr. No NC baseline. Estimation Engineer should use midpoint as base rate with explicit range documentation.
warnings.recommendation: Use midpoint rates with rate_range_low and rate_range_high fields.

warnings.topic: MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT is shared but not yet built
warnings.message: The lead-safe RRP shared module is referenced by research but has not been built in any spec yet. This spec should include it as a conditional reference but the module definition will be shared across all 9 interior RP specs.
warnings.recommendation: SOP Librarian should define the module inline in this first RP spec. Future RP specs reference it.
